title: Lakshya Sen Advances to Japan Masters Round of 16
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen continues his strong form by progressing in a Super 750 tournament.
summary: Lakshya Sen secured his spot in the Round of 16 at the Japan Masters 2026, marking his first competitive appearance since his Hylo Open title win.

title: Srikanth Overcomes Gemke in Japan Masters Opener
indian_angle: Veteran Indian shuttler Kidambi Srikanth showed resilience to win his opening match at the Japan Masters.
summary: Kidambi Srikanth advanced to the Round of 16 at the Japan Masters 2026, coming back from a game down to defeat Rasmus Gemke.

title: Riyan Malhan, Indian-Origin Shuttler, Wins Youth Olympic Gold
indian_angle: Though representing UAE, 16-year-old Riyan Malhan, with roots in New Delhi, achieved a significant milestone by winning a Youth Olympic badminton title.
summary: Riyan Malhan, a 16-year-old badminton player with New Delhi roots, secured a Youth Olympic gold medal in Senegal, though he represents the UAE.

title: Tanvi Patri's Unique Badminton Journey Forged in China
indian_angle: This feature highlights the development of Tanvi Patri, a promising Indian badminton talent aiming for top international titles and Olympic qualification.
summary: India's rising badminton star, Tanvi Patri, is profiled for her unique training journey in China as she sets her sights on a world junior title and qualification for the LA Olympics.
